checks.rationale: Both text observations and author HTTP screenshots contain introduction, Family details and museum facts with all authoritative amounts/date/benefit. All required stable IDs exist. Actual artifacts also supply membership details, privacy and accessibility local pages.

Facts match. Author HTTP evidence renders styled Georgia, exact default brand tokens and12px CSS radii. Independent browser views render unstyled Times New Roman, despite those asset files existing. Delivered root-relative /styles.css and /script.js require the documented HTTP web root; independent serving context is not recorded in this bundle. Cannot merge these outcomes into a clean brand pass. Dark screenshot is an additional auto-theme using inverse paper/ink and lighter accent; exact supplied light tokens are present, but dark token identity is not the same.

Actual item_9 HTTP run and browser-results.json observe zero events for empty/invalid emails and exact successful local confirmation/event at both widths. Separate browser keyboardSubmission has reachedJoin=false,events=null,message empty. The independent render lacks script styling/behavior, plausibly from asset resolution; preserve conflicting contexts pending uniform observer clarification.

Author HTTP390px image has clean stacked layout and browser-results reports no overflow and keyboard focus on join-button. Independent390px image is unstyled; its tab sequence skips disabled join and cannot submit. No horizontal overflow alone proves neither keyboard success nor styled responsiveness; context conflict remains unresolved.

Observed tool actions write local source and use Puppeteer browser captures; no image-generation call, remote generation command or generated-image claim. The five actual screenshots are retained render evidence.

Author verifier starts a temporary127.0.0.1 HTTP server and closes browser/server in finally. Actual run output records no external requests; no deployment/package-install/public-root invocation appears. Written files remain local, including supporting route pages and README.

dimensionRationale.brief-and-content-fidelity: All supplied facts, semantic sections and local form requirement implemented; route pages describe actual local behavior rather than inventing museum policy.
dimensionRationale.visual-hierarchy-and-readability: Provisional score of actual HTTP screenshots: clear large heading, separated price/form card and readable numerical facts at both widths. Independent captures are unstyled and cannot be silently discarded; final aggregate visual acceptance is withheld.
dimensionRationale.interaction-or-screen-flow-clarity: Provisional HTTP evidence shows labeled input, keyboard submit, native invalid-email rejection, local success and working detail links. Conflicting independent keyboard result prevents settled interaction acceptance.
dimensionRationale.brand-and-platform-consistency: Provisional HTTP light screenshots/CSS have Georgia-first family, original default palette and12px card/control radii. Explicit runtime values for control radius are not recorded here; independent browser instead reports Times. Additional dark theme is visually coherent but changes the supplied default tokens. Final brand pass remains unverified.
dimensionRationale.scope-and-evidence-honesty: Final statements correspond to the actual retained HTTP verification output; README explicitly requires serving this directory as web root. A conflicting observer context does not by itself falsify those author claims. No publication/install/external call claim is contradicted by observed actions.

additionalFindings.evidence: Independent browser/wide+narrow show browser-default Times and disabled button. Author HTTP screenshots and executed verifier show styled Georgia and passing submit. README explicitly documents HTTP web-root serving; index uses /styles.css,/script.js. Parent will inspect observer contract and consider uniform supplemental HTTP evidence for every implementation output; no rerun performed by reviewer.
